description_en: Queries the virtual private clouds (VPCs) and transit routers (TRs) associated with an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）关联的专有网络（VPC）和转发路由器（TR）
name: DescribeExpressConnectRouterAssociation

parameters.help_en:
The Express Connect Router (ECR) instance ID.
You can create an ECR instance and obtain the EcrId by calling the CreateExpressConnectRouter API operation
parameters.help_zh:
专线网关实例ID。
可通过 CreateExpressConnectRouter API 创建 ECR 实例并获取 EcrId
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en: The associate ID between the Express Connect Router (ECR) and a VPC or TR
parameters.name: association_id

parameters.help_en: The region to which the VPC or TR belongs
parameters.name: association_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the associated resource. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud.

TR: transit router
parameters.help_zh:
关联的资源类型：

VPC：专有网络。

TR：转发路由器
parameters.name: association_node_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC-connected instance
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the transit router instance
parameters.name: transit_router_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:
You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no next query exists.
If a next query exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 2147483647. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量。取值范围：1~2147483647。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without modifying EPS resources.
false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en: The tag key of the resource. Once specified, the value cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 资源的标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the resource. The tag value can be an empty string and can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 资源的标签值。可以为空字符串，最多支持128个字符，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The list of tags.

You can bind up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh:
标签列表。

最多可以绑定20个标签
parameters.name: tag

AllowedPrefixesMode.description_en:
The prefix route mode. Valid values:
MatchMode: match mode.
IncrementalMode: incremental mode
AllowedPrefixesMode.description_zh:
前缀路由模式，取值：
MatchMode: 匹配模式
IncrementalMode: 增量模式

AssociationId.description_en: The associate ID between the Express Connect Router (ECR) and a VPC or TR

AssociationNodeType.description_en:
The type of the associated resource. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud.

TR: transit router
AssociationNodeType.description_zh:
关联的资源类型：

VPC：专有网络。

TR：转发路由器

Description.description_en: The description of the associated resource

EcrId.description_en: The Express Connect Router (ECR) instance ID

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the association was created. The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format
GmtCreate.description_zh: 创建关联的时间。按照 ISO8601 标准表示，并需要使用 UTC 时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the association was modified. The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format
GmtModified.description_zh: 修改关联的时间。按照 ISO8601 标准表示，并需要使用 UTC 时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

OwnerId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the resource belongs
OwnerId.description_zh: 资源所属的阿里云账号ID

RegionId.description_en: The region to which the resource belongs

Status.description_en:
The deployment status of the associated resource. Valid values:

CREATING: being created.

ACTIVE: created.

INACTIVE: the Express Connect Router (ECR) is associated with the transit router, and the transit router is pending to attach the Express Connect Router (ECR) for routing and forwarding.

ASSOCIATING: being attached.

DISSOCIATING: being dissociated.

UPDATING: being modified.

DELETING: being deleted
Status.description_zh:
关联资源的部署状态。可能值：

CREATING：创建中。

ACTIVE：已创建。

INACTIVE：专线网关关联转发路由器，待转发路由器关联专线网关状态。

ASSOCIATING：资源绑定中。

DISSOCIATING：资源解绑中。

UPDATING：修改中。

DELETING：删除中

Tags.description_en: The list of tags bound to the associated resource
Tags.description_zh: 关联资源绑定的标签列表

TransitRouterId.description_en: The ID of the transit router instance

TransitRouterName.description_en: The name of the transit router instance
TransitRouterName.description_zh: 转发路由器实例的名称

TransitRouterOwnerId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the transit router belongs
TransitRouterOwnerId.description_zh: 转发路由器所属的阿里云账号ID

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC-connected instance

VpcName.description_en: The name of the VPC-connected instance

VpcOwnerId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the VPC belongs

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure. For more information about error codes, see error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为 200 表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace the `%s` in the ErrMessage return parameter.

If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, the request parameter DtsJobId is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的 `%s`。

如果ErrMessage **返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage 返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId**不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 2147483647. Default value: 20
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量。取值范围：1~2147483647。默认值：20

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no next query exists.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

True: successful.
False: failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

True：成功。
False：失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of associated resources
